`report.schema.json` is the unchanged Draft RFC 0027 proposal schema from
Judgment-Pack/judgment-pack-spec commit
`5bc71c1cafbb3df2ac045e90326716c6e6c5dd83`,
`rfcs/pack-design-advisories/report.schema.json`. It is a test-only shape oracle,
not a released Core artifact or conformance manifest. Runtime examples and expected
findings in the adjacent Go tests are hand-authored.
